cases.name: card_tap

cases.name: card_tap_ack_not_ok
cases.note: The ack changes the look only, not what was sent.

cases.name: drift_8_8_is_a_tap
cases.note: 8 px sideways and 8 down is 11.3 px: still a tap.

cases.name: drift_9_9_is_no_tap
cases.note: 9 and 9 is 12.7 px: no card tap, no swipe.

cases.name: drift_13_and_back_is_no_tap
cases.note: Once 12 px are passed, coming back does not make the press a tap again.

cases.name: drift_13_and_back_is_no_hold

cases.name: slow_swipe_from_a_card

cases.name: swipe_right_wraps
cases.note: From the first normal page to the last normal page; never a detail page.

cases.name: hold_opens_the_page

cases.name: bar_with_change

cases.name: hold_on_a_slider_is_none
cases.note: No hold on a slider with change; its release sends.

cases.name: unavailable_card_tap
cases.note: Card 2 with un 1: nothing is sent.

cases.name: unavailable_card_hold
cases.note: A go still works on an unavailable card.

cases.name: unavailable_card_slider
cases.note: Card 2's bar with un 1: the slider's press, and nothing is sent.

cases.name: unavailable_card_slider_hold
cases.note: A slider with change has no hold, also in an unavailable card.

cases.name: unavailable_card_label_tap
cases.note: A label only shows: the press is the card's, and the card sends nothing.

cases.name: unavailable_card_label_hold
cases.note: The card's hold, from its label: the go still works.

cases.name: choice_cell
cases.note: Card 4, first choice: the third of four cells.

cases.name: choice_gap
cases.note: Between the first two cells: nothing.

cases.name: choice_released_in_another_cell
cases.note: Down in the first cell of the icon choice, up in the cell under it.

cases.name: choice_asks_first
cases.note: The swatches have cf and a confirm text: the question opens, nothing is sent yet.

cases.name: upright_slider
cases.note: Bottom to top: 160 px of 200 from the bottom edge is 80. A press on a slider with change is never a swipe.

cases.name: track_slider_is_never_a_swipe
cases.note: 156 px to the left on the hue track: (16 - 7) / 330 of 360 is 9.8, on the step 10.

cases.name: bar_track_half_rounds_up
cases.note: Half way on the white track is 4250; 22.5 steps of 100 round up to 4300.

cases.name: image_with_hold_tap

cases.name: child_tap_is_never_the_cards
cases.note: The switch of the Routing card.

cases.name: thermostat_plus
cases.note: 21.5 and a step of 0.5.

cases.name: swap_both_hidden
cases.note: vis without a value hides: the press goes to the card.

cases.name: hidden_while_the_finger_is_down
cases.note: Arm is pressed, then a tab_set swaps the two: the release sends nothing.

cases.name: hold_on_a_child_with_tap
cases.note: Arm has a tap and no hold: the card's hold.

cases.name: faded_part_that_only_shows
cases.note: The bar has no value and no change: the press is the card's.

cases.name: faded_control
cases.note: The switch has no value: no input, and not the card's.

cases.name: back_entry
cases.note: Hold to open page 3, then the side bar's back entry.

note: Presses on layout_v2_kit, for a tablet that speaks version 2, is paired with secret_hex, has a session with nonce and sends; each case starts on a fresh screen at least 60 s after power-on (no erase watch), on 'page', with the slot values 'slots' ([device slot, value]). 'touch': [ms, 'down' | 'move' | 'up', x, y]. 'sets': [ms, [[slot, value], ...]], a tab_set that arrives while the finger is down. 'acks': [ms, ok, code]. Expected: 'events', each [widget id, event, confirmed, value], in order (value null for a tap); 'end_page', the page shown at the end; 'question', 1 when the question box is open at the end. These are written by hand from contract 4.3 and 7.4. A case with 'payload' and 'verdict' is also input for HA: feed those cases in order (last_counter starts at 0 and moves on 'ok'); 'run' says whether HA runs the input after the checks of contract 7.3 (2), with 'sent' (else the file's 'sent') as the values HA last sent this tablet. A touch case with 'counter' emits that 'payload' for its first event when the tablet's next counter is 'counter'.
